page_title: Graduation Procedure | New Mexico Tech Catalog
sentence: Ensure you meet the minimum GPA requirement of 2.0.

page_title: Graduation Procedure | New Mexico Tech Catalog
sentence: NMT Commencement: The ceremony is open to all students who are planning to graduate, have completed the Petition to Graduate form, and are on track with program completion by the spring semester.

page_title: Academic Policies | New Mexico Tech Catalog
sentence: If a student’s overall graduate GPA is below a 3.0, permission to repeat specific courses (with grades of B‐, C+ or C) may be requested from the Graduate Dean to meet graduation requirements.
Students in good academic standing at other colleges and universities (2.0 minimum GPA) are eligible for transfer admission to New Mexico Tech.
(If you have fewer than 30 credit hours of transfer credit, or if you completed college credit as dual credit, follow the regular Freshman/first-year Admission section above.)
The applicant must present official college transcripts showing a cumulative GPA of 2.0 or better.

page_title: Student Government Association (SGA) | New Mexico Tech Catalog
sentence: The Student Senate carries out its functions through the creation of its own committees, and its deliberations are open to all students and other interested persons.
